# @generated by `kubaos-tokens` from system/files/grub/theme.txt.in and
# design/tokens.toml. Change those and run `cargo run -p kubaos-tokens -- write`.
# KubaOS GRUB theme. Installed to /boot/grub/themes/kubaos by
# install_boot_theme (system/lib.sh), which renders the .pf2 fonts this file
# names next to it with grub-mkfont (Geist, Geist Medium and Geist Mono, from
# system/files/fonts). The PNGs come from branding/boot.py and
# branding/neon.py.
#
# `kubaos-tokens` writes theme.txt from this template, working out each name in
# double braces from design/tokens.toml: `color.ROLE` is the role in the dark palette,
# `font.STYLE` the font of a type style, and anything else a sum of lengths in
# device pixels, each token times GRUB's scale (`boot.grub_scale`, 1.5),
# `png.NAME.width` or `.height` a picture's here, as it is.
#
# GRUB draws in device pixels at the firmware's native mode (GRUB_GFXMODE=auto)
# and can't tell how big the screen is, so the menu is drawn at 1.5, the
# desktop's own scale on the laptop's 2880x1800 panel; a 1080p screen shows it
# half as large again as its desktop.
title-text: ""

desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-image-scale-method: "stretch"
terminal-font: "Geist Mono Regular 18"
terminal-left: "8%"
terminal-top: "8%"
terminal-width: "84%"
terminal-height: "80%"
terminal-border: "0"
terminal-box: "terminal_box_*.png"

# glow is its own clear space, and the menu right under it, room for four
# entries.

# The entries are `ListRow`s, `row` tall and `space.s4` apart, the picked one
# in `secondary_container`, as a list's selected row. GRUB draws an entry's box
# (item_*, select_*) round its text with the borders outside `item_height`:
# boot.py makes the borders the room the row leaves round its line, and the
# spacing takes them back.
